query: Build a checklist app my sales voice agent can tick off during a call, and give me the link.
expected_behavior: Resolves workspace scope with ttai:get_workspace_info (organizations) before ttai:create_filebase with kind app
Separates fixed render code (src/App.tsx) from one flat JSON data file the agent edits
Writes README.md in the first ttai:write_filebase call (# Title, a one-line description, ## Data, ## Controls, ## Rules) and no spec.json; the result's missing list is empty and its warning is empty
Re-reads with ttai:get_resource (type filebases, paths) and checks the file listing has every imported file
Opens the result's view_url (or, when absent, a ttai:create_token filebase_view link) to confirm the app renders, and says the link expires

query: Attach my 'deal-room' app to the Enterprise Discovery Call scenario.
expected_behavior: Resolves the Scenario ID and reads its current tools_config before writing
Calls ttai:update_scenario with tools_config.tools.agent_desktop, copying the existing agent_desktop tool_settings keys because tool_settings is replaced whole
Sets tool_settings.apps as a map keyed by app name ({"deal-room": true}) and add_to_system_prompt true so the app reaches the prompt
Says the change applies to new sessions only

query: Change the 'roadmap' app so the agent can highlight one item at a time.
expected_behavior: Finds the app with ttai:list_resources (type filebases, kind app) and reads its README.md and the data file before editing
Adds a highlight field to the data file and a README ## Data / ## Controls line describing it, then writes both with ttai:write_filebase; adds no spec.json
Confirms before overwriting files of an app a Scenario already uses
Never prints a preview token outside the link handed to the user

query: Build a scoreboard app my quiz voice agent updates after every answer: team names, scores, and the current question number.
expected_behavior: Reads references/app-structure.md and references/runtime.md before the first ttai:write_filebase
Puts the scoreboard state in one flat JSON file under data/ (for example data/score.json) and documents its fields in README.md
src/App.tsx reads it with import files from "./desktop-files" and parses files["data/…"] inside the component on every render, with a waiting state for missing or invalid JSON
No src/ file imports from data/ (no "../data/…" module import); package.json, if written, lists only allowlisted packages
README ## Controls tell the agent to rewrite the whole data file with the app's _write tool before speaking

query: Build a flashcard app my language tutor agent flips through, then check that it actually works.
expected_behavior: Writes no spec.json; README.md has # Title, a one-line description, ## Data (the data/ files and their shapes), ## Controls (which file to write to drive the app) and ## Rules
Gives the title and description to ttai:create_filebase; the live agent writes only whole files under data/

After ttai:write_filebase, opens the result's view_url in a browser to confirm the app compiles and renders; with &debug=1 reads compile errors (file:line) and whether an agent write patched in place or recompiled
If the result carries no view_url (older server), falls back to ttai:create_token with type filebase_view
If the write result has a warning such as 'spec.json is not read', moves that guidance into README.md and deletes spec.json
